shared.devui.case_primary: Primary: one per place, named by its outcome
shared.devui.case_destructive: Destructive: red text on the page, filled red only to confirm
shared.devui.case_header_list: List or overview: breadcrumbs, title, description, one primary action
shared.devui.case_header_record: A record: avatar, status, key facts, the breadcrumb ending at the record
shared.devui.case_header_back: A document: back button before the title
shared.devui.case_activity_recent: Digest on an overview: the latest few, with See all
shared.devui.case_stat_tile: StatTile: a count that opens its list; loaded, loading, failed
shared.devui.case_filter_chip: FilterChip: unset, set, a value too long
shared.devui.case_inline_edit: Editable: click, then Enter saves, Esc cancels
shared.devui.case_form_section: FormSection: every field type, with labels, hints and errors
shared.devui.case_section_stack: One after another: a rule separates them
shared.devui.use_page: a page fits no other template: the home page, an area overview.
shared.devui.avoid_page: a more specific template fits; every other template is built on Page.
shared.devui.use_list: listing documents or master data to find, filter and open; a small configuration list edits each item in a FormModal.
shared.devui.avoid_list: viewing or editing one record: a record has its own page, the side panel only previews.
shared.devui.use_record: one record without a lifecycle: an employee, a customer, a user; key facts in the header, each part a full-width tab, the Overview tab to read and edit each group of values.
shared.devui.avoid_record: the record has a number, a date and a draft, pending, posted lifecycle: use DocumentPage.
shared.devui.use_document: viewing and editing one document, from draft to posted or cancelled, with its approval.
shared.devui.avoid_document: the record has no lifecycle: use RecordPage; never split off a separate edit page.
shared.devui.use_inbox: working through pending items one by one: the list beside the selected item's detail.
shared.devui.avoid_inbox: searching or filtering many records: use ListPage.
shared.devui.use_auth: a screen outside the app shell, before there is a session: sign-in.
shared.devui.avoid_auth: the user is signed in: every screen inside the app uses another template.
shared.devui.case_read_only: Product off but its data still shown: ReadOnlyBanner
shared.devui.case_no_results: Filters hide everything: EmptyState with a way out
shared.devui.case_error: Could not load: ErrorState with Retry
shared.devui.use_action_region: The region's list or content sits here.
shared.devui.case_modal_footer: A modal's own buttons in a band at the bottom: ModalFooter
shared.devui.case_form_fields: Fields of a card edited in place, no section title: FormFields

shared.devui.principles_hint: What every screen follows, and the voice of its text.
shared.devui.p_dense: Dense and calm: 14px text, 30px controls, 40px rows; space from the 4px scale, separation from thin borders.
shared.devui.p_flat: Flat until it floats: pages are flat surfaces divided by borders; only overlays cast a shadow.
shared.devui.p_colour: Colour means something: primary marks action and selection, green, orange, red, blue and purple mark state, grey carries the rest.
shared.devui.p_radius: Radius follows role: 4px tags, 6px controls and frames, 8px menus, round for people.
shared.devui.p_one_way: One way per job: two screens doing the same job use the same component.
shared.devui.p_backend: The backend decides, the UI displays: buttons come from allowed actions, messages from error codes.
shared.devui.p_one_page: A record has one page: lists lead to it, a side panel only previews, each card is edited in place.
shared.devui.p_one_primary: One primary action per place, named by its outcome; the rest are secondary or behind "…".
shared.devui.p_undo: Ask before what cannot be undone; offer Undo for what can.
shared.devui.p_errors: Errors stay next to their cause; successes toast; nothing fails silently.
shared.devui.p_url: The URL is the state: filters, sort, page, tab and the open side panel; Back always works.
shared.devui.p_server: The server computes: totals, numbers and statuses come from the API.
shared.devui.voice_short: Short, neutral, impersonal: no "you", no "please", no exclamation marks.
shared.devui.voice_imperative: Imperative for instructions: "Choose the pay period".
shared.devui.voice_sentence: Sentence case everywhere, buttons and titles included.
shared.devui.voice_plain: Plain words over system words: "Posted", never a status or error code.
shared.devui.colour_hint: Screens name a colour by meaning (color="success"), never by step.
shared.devui.colour_steps: 0 tint · 1 badge tint · 6 filled · 7 text on tint · 8 badge text.
shared.devui.ramp_primary: The one primary action, links, focus, selected item; also info.
shared.devui.ramp_discovery: Something new or in beta; nothing else.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_color_error: Field errors and the required mark.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_color_border: Dividers, table rules, frames, outlined buttons.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_color_input_bo: Edges of text fields, a step stronger than border.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_color_elevatio: Group and total rows, tile hover, cells that take no value.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_color_primary_: Selected state, everywhere: navigation, menus, options, inbox rows.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_control_height: Every button, input and select, wherever it sits; 40px in form sections and modals.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_side_width: The inbox list; the least a document's side column shrinks to.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_content_width: Forms and a document's main column stop here.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_detail_width: A record's or document's page, both columns.
shared.devui.typography_hint: Inter, lines on a 4px grid; at most three heading levels on a page.
shared.devui.type_h1: Page title, one per page, set by the page template.
shared.devui.type_xs: Captions, column headers, badges, field labels. The minimum size.
shared.devui.type_sm: Body text, table cells, inputs, buttons.
shared.devui.type_xl: Modal titles, stat values in tiles.
shared.devui.weight_600: Field labels, column headers, totals, emphasis.
shared.devui.spacing_hint: A closed 4px scale: a gap that seems to need another value needs another level of layout instead.
shared.devui.space_xxxs: Between a line and its caption.
shared.devui.space_xxs: Icon to its text, label to its input.
shared.devui.space_xs: Controls in one strip, rows of a field list.
shared.devui.space_lg: Between page regions and form sections.
shared.devui.space_xl: Page side padding from 1024px, empty-state padding.
shared.devui.surfaces_hint: A card on the page is framed, never shadowed; only overlays float.
shared.devui.radius_md: Default: buttons, inputs, cards, table frames, modals.
shared.devui.elevation_sunken: Sunken: group and total rows, unavailable cells.
shared.devui.elevation_flat: Flat: the page and everything on it, framed.
shared.devui.elevation_footer: Pinned footer: a form's footer while content scrolls under it.
shared.devui.icons_hint: Tabler, outline, stroke 1.5, always through the icon constant; decorative icons sit next to text.
shared.devui.icon_button: In every button, alerts, icon buttons.
shared.devui.alert_info: Amounts are as of the last payroll run.
shared.devui.alert_success: All timesheets of the period are closed.
shared.devui.alert_warning: Inputs changed after the payroll was computed. Compute it again.
shared.devui.alert_danger: March is locked. Contact accounting to change this document.
shared.devui.alert_discovery: New: print templates can be edited per legal entity.

shared.devui.storybook: Every prop and state in Storybook (make storybook)
shared.devui.about_button: The kit's button, used directly with the variants below; shared/ui has no wrapper.
shared.devui.use_button: an action on a page, in a section, or in a form or dialog footer.
shared.devui.avoid_button: going to another page: use Anchor; a row's actions: put them in MoreActions.
shared.devui.dont_two_primary: Two primary buttons side by side: users cannot tell which step comes first.
shared.devui.layer_start_note: What is here and where to look
shared.devui.layer_foundations_note: Values read live from the theme
shared.devui.layer_kit_note: The only @mmerp/ui names areas import directly; the rest is in Storybook
shared.devui.layer_mmerp_note: Ready-made in shared; use before building your own
shared.devui.overview_hint: mmerp's design language, live, in six layers from the base up.
shared.devui.overview_rules_text: This page shows; the written rules live in the mmerp-ui skill and docs/ui.md, including UI text and accessibility.
shared.devui.about_anchor: The kit's link: goes somewhere, a real <a> element.
shared.devui.use_anchor: opening a record, another page, a phone number or an email.
shared.devui.avoid_anchor: doing something on the page: use Button, even when it looks like a link.
shared.devui.about_layout_text: The kit's layout and text primitives, given theme values only.
shared.devui.use_layout_text: arranging items inside a region and showing plain text.
shared.devui.avoid_layout_text: laying out a whole page: use a page template; a region heading: use Section or Panel.
shared.devui.about_loader: The kit's spinner, for a short, small wait.
shared.devui.use_loader: a small part loading whose shape is unknown.
shared.devui.avoid_loader: a page or region loading: use PageSkeleton or ContentSkeleton; a running button: Button loading.
shared.devui.about_skeleton: The kit's placeholder block, holding the shape of content to come.
shared.devui.use_skeleton: a small part with its own shape, such as a number on a tile.
shared.devui.avoid_skeleton: a page or region: use PageSkeleton or ContentSkeleton, not a stack of Skeletons.
shared.devui.about_tooltip: Names a control that has no text, on hover or focus.
shared.devui.avoid_tooltip: long explanations or anything users must read: put it on the page.
shared.devui.about_activity_feed: Everything that happened to a record on one timeline: comments, changes, status moves, views.
shared.devui.use_activity_feed: a record or document Activity tab, or the latest few items in the side column.
shared.devui.about_approval_panel: Who approves a document and which step it is at, with approve or reject for whoever is next.
shared.devui.use_approval_panel: the side column of a document page with approval.
shared.devui.avoid_approval_panel: records without a lifecycle: there is nothing to approve.
shared.devui.about_attachment_panel: A record's attachments: upload, download, delete.
shared.devui.use_attachment_panel: a record or document that carries papers.
shared.devui.avoid_attachment_panel: importing data from a file: use ImportDialog.
shared.devui.about_bulk_bar: Replaces the filter bar once rows are selected: the count and the bulk actions.
shared.devui.use_bulk_bar: a list that lets one action run on many rows.
shared.devui.avoid_bulk_bar: a single row: its actions sit at the row end.
shared.devui.about_cell_grid: A grid of inputs along two axes, like a timesheet by person and day.
shared.devui.use_cell_grid: entering many small values of one kind by row and column.
shared.devui.avoid_cell_grid: document lines with columns of different kinds: use LinesTable.
shared.devui.about_data_table: A read-only table for a list of records; columns have a role and kind, with sort, groups and selection.
shared.devui.use_data_table: listing records to find and open each one.
shared.devui.avoid_data_table: entering lines: use LinesTable; entering a grid: use CellGrid.
shared.devui.about_document_preview: A document at a glance: status and a few key values, in an inbox or side panel.
shared.devui.use_document_preview: previewing a document without leaving the list.
shared.devui.avoid_document_preview: the full view or editing: open the document page.
shared.devui.about_document_status: The badge for the four document statuses, fixed colours: draft, pending, posted, cancelled.
shared.devui.avoid_document_status: a module's own progress (delivery, payment): use StatusBadge.
shared.devui.about_editable_panel: A group of a record's values in a card, edited in place with its own Save.
shared.devui.avoid_editable_panel: a single value: use InlineEditField; creating: a form in FormModal or a create page.
shared.devui.about_field_list: Read-only label–value pairs: dimmed label left, value right, "—" when empty.
shared.devui.avoid_field_list: many records: use DataTable; a few headline facts under the title: use KeyFacts.
shared.devui.about_filters: The filter bar family: search, choice chip, org unit, legal entity, month, year and status filters.
shared.devui.use_filters: narrowing a list; values live on the URL.
shared.devui.avoid_filters: entering data in a form: use the Form fields.
shared.devui.about_form: Form and its fields bound to React Hook Form: labels, required marks, server errors beside the field.
shared.devui.avoid_form: filtering a list: use Filters; one value edited in place: use InlineEditField.
shared.devui.about_form_modal: A dialog holding a short form, its primary button right in the footer.
shared.devui.use_form_modal: creating or editing a small item in a settings list.
shared.devui.avoid_form_modal: documents or large records: use their own page; a yes/no question: use useConfirm.
shared.devui.about_inline_edit_field: A value you click to edit in place; Enter saves, Esc cancels.
shared.devui.avoid_inline_edit_field: a group of related values: use EditablePanel.
shared.devui.about_key_facts: A few headline facts under a record page's title.
shared.devui.use_key_facts: summarising a record in its header.
shared.devui.avoid_key_facts: the full list of values: use FieldList in a Panel.
shared.devui.about_lines_table: Document lines: add, remove, Tab between cells, totals below; also read-only.
shared.devui.avoid_lines_table: a list of records: use DataTable.
shared.devui.about_more_actions: The "…" button holding actions not worth a button; destructive ones go last.
shared.devui.use_more_actions: the page header beyond three buttons, or a row end with two or more actions.
shared.devui.avoid_more_actions: the primary action: always a visible button.
shared.devui.about_notice: A banner at the top of the region it is about; colour by meaning, always with an icon.
shared.devui.use_notice: a whole-document error, a warning, or information to read before acting.
shared.devui.avoid_notice: a field error: under the field; a finished result: use notify.
shared.devui.about_notify: A short toast about something that happened: success, a background failure, undo.
shared.devui.avoid_notify: asking the user, or an open form's error: put it beside its cause.
shared.devui.about_panel: A titled card holding one group of values on a record page.
shared.devui.use_panel: a read-only group of values or a short list in the side column.
shared.devui.avoid_panel: an editable group: use EditablePanel; a region on a non-record page: use Section.
shared.devui.about_person_avatar: Initials on a colour derived from the name, so a person always looks the same.
shared.devui.use_person_avatar: showing a person: beside the name in lists, headers, activity.
shared.devui.avoid_person_avatar: organisations or units: use the name, not an avatar.
shared.devui.about_query_view: Picks what a region fed by one query shows: loading, error, empty, no results, data.
shared.devui.use_query_view: every region that reads from the server.
shared.devui.avoid_query_view: writing loading, error and empty branches by hand.
shared.devui.about_section: A titled region with a description and actions on a page that is not a form.
shared.devui.use_section: splitting an overview or settings page into parts.
shared.devui.avoid_section: inside a form: use FormSection; on a record page: use Panel.
shared.devui.about_side_panel: A side panel previewing a row without leaving the list; on the URL.
shared.devui.use_side_panel: previewing rows while going through a list.
shared.devui.avoid_side_panel: editing or the full view: the record has its own page.
shared.devui.about_states: Ready-made states: page and region skeletons, empty, error, read-only, not found, forbidden.
shared.devui.use_states: a region or page with nothing to show yet.
shared.devui.avoid_states: building your own; a region fed by one query: let QueryView pick.
shared.devui.about_status_badge: A record's status badge, coloured by meaning, always naming the status.
shared.devui.use_status_badge: a module's own status or progress.
shared.devui.about_tiles: Tiles for home and overview pages: a count tile opens a list, a link tile opens a page.
shared.devui.use_tiles: entry points to an area's lists and pages.
shared.devui.about_tree_list: A hierarchy like an org chart: collapsible branches, lines back to the parent.
shared.devui.use_tree_list: data with parents and children over several levels.
shared.devui.avoid_tree_list: a flat list: use DataTable with row groups.
shared.devui.about_use_action: Runs a region's action: asks first when it cannot be undone, keeps the error by the region, toasts success.
shared.devui.use_use_action: a button that does something on the server outside a form.
shared.devui.avoid_use_action: submitting a form: Form handles errors and state.
shared.devui.about_use_confirm: A confirmation dialog; its confirm button repeats the exact verb.
shared.devui.use_use_confirm: before deleting, cancelling or any step the server cannot undo.
shared.devui.avoid_use_confirm: undoable changes: apply and offer Undo; needs input: use FormModal.
shared.devui.about_filter_search: Narrowing a long list with a search box and filter chips, values on the URL.
shared.devui.use_filter_search: a list longer than one page.
shared.devui.avoid_filter_search: filtering a paged list in the browser; a list of a few items: it needs no filter.
shared.devui.about_create_edit: Creating or editing: a small item in a dialog, a record's values in place by group.
shared.devui.avoid_create_edit: a separate edit page for a record that already has a page.
shared.devui.about_confirm_delete: A destructive action: last in the menu, confirmed with its exact verb, its error kept by the region.
shared.devui.use_confirm_delete: deleting, cancelling or anything that cannot be undone.
shared.devui.avoid_confirm_delete: undoable changes: apply and offer Undo.
shared.devui.about_loading_empty_error: A region that reads data goes through loading, error, empty or no results before it has data.
shared.devui.use_loading_empty_error: every region that reads from the server.
shared.devui.avoid_loading_empty_error: a blank page or a spinner that says nothing.
shared.devui.about_bulk: Selecting many rows for one action; clicking a row to preview it.
shared.devui.use_bulk: lists where users often handle many rows at once.
shared.devui.avoid_bulk: actions that only ever apply to one row.
shared.devui.about_document_approval: A document moves from draft through pending to posted; approvers see their step in the side column.
shared.devui.about_auth: The frame for screens outside the app, before a session exists.
shared.devui.about_document: A document's page: header, sections, a side column for approval and activity.
shared.devui.about_inbox: A list of items to process beside the detail of the selected one.
shared.devui.about_list: A list with filter bar, table, paging and side panel, its state on the URL.
shared.devui.about_page: The frame every other template builds on: breadcrumbs, title, status, actions.
shared.devui.about_record: A record page without a lifecycle: a summary in the header, one tab per part.
shared.devui.case_group_stack: Group lays out in a row, Stack in a column
shared.devui.dont_loader_region: A spinner in an empty region: users cannot tell what is coming; use ContentSkeleton.
shared.devui.dont_skeleton_stack: A hand-built stack of Skeletons for a whole region: use ContentSkeleton or PageSkeleton.
shared.devui.dont_tooltip_repeat: A tooltip repeating the button text: it adds nothing but noise.
shared.devui.do_table_numbers: Numbers and money use kind "number": right-aligned, locale-formatted.
shared.devui.dont_table_own: A hand-written <Table> in an area: lint blocks it; every list goes through DataTable.
shared.devui.case_stacked: Label above value, in a narrow card
shared.devui.dont_badge_tone: A tone that does not match the meaning: green for a neutral status.
shared.devui.dont_danger_first: A destructive action first in the menu: easy to hit by mistake; put it last, after a divider.
shared.devui.do_confirm_verb: The confirm button repeats the exact verb: "Cancel document".
shared.devui.dont_confirm_yes: A "Yes" or "OK" confirm button: users must reread the question.
shared.devui.do_filter_url: Filters live on the URL and go to the server; clearing them restores the full list.
shared.devui.dont_filter_client: Filtering a paged list in the browser: it only filters the page on screen.
shared.devui.case_create_modal: Creating a small item in a dialog
shared.devui.case_edit_in_place: Editing a group of values in place
shared.devui.dont_confirm_undoable: Asking to confirm something undoable: apply it and offer Undo.
shared.devui.edit_in_place_see: Each group of a record's values is an EditablePanel, edited in place with its own Save.
shared.error.invalid_delegation: The approval delegation is not valid.
shared.error.approval_already_voted: This person already voted on this step.
shared.error.approval_already_approver: This person is already an approver on this step.
shared.rule.drop_otherwise: A parallel split has no otherwise branch; the steps in otherwise will be deleted.
shared.rule.rejections: How many rejections send it back
shared.rule.due_hours_hint: Leave empty for no due time. When it passes, the approvers and the submitter are reminded.
shared.rule.reason.invalid_due: The due time must be from 1 to 720 hours.
shared.rule.reason.two_kinds: Holds two kinds at once; keep only one.
shared.rule.reason.too_large: The rule is too large: at most 50 steps, 50 conditions and 5 nested splits.
shared.rule.reason.otherwise_on_parallel: A parallel split has no otherwise branch.
shared.rule.reason.unknown_role: This role no longer exists. Choose another role.
shared.rule.reason.approvals_exceed_user: More approvals needed than users chosen.
shared.rule.reason.no_module_approvers: This document type has no approvers of its own. Choose a role or users.
shared.rule.reason.invalid_condition: The condition is not valid. Check the field, comparison and value.
shared.rule.step_hint: One person or a group approves
shared.rule.case_hint: This branch runs when the condition below holds.
shared.rule.branch_hint: This branch runs when the condition below holds; with no condition it always runs.
shared.rule.otherwise_hint: Runs when no case holds. Left empty, no more approval is needed.
shared.rule.split_hint.one: Cases are checked left to right; the first that holds runs. When none holds, "Otherwise" runs.
shared.rule.split_hint.all: Every branch whose condition holds runs at once; the flow goes on when all have approved.
shared.rule.parallel_join: Goes on when every branch is done
shared.rule.empty_hint: Nobody approves yet. Press + to add the first approver.
shared.rule.panel_hint: Click a box on the diagram to edit it. Press + on a connector to add a step or a split right there.
shared.rule.reason.fallback_required: Choose who receives it when no approver is found.
shared.rule.empty_readonly: Nobody approves: the document takes effect as soon as it is sent.
shared.rule.panel_hint_readonly: Click a box on the diagram to see its details.
shared.approval.withdraw_confirm: Withdraw this approval request? The document stays as it is; the approvals given so far are dropped.
shared.error.awaiting_approval: The document awaits approval of a request.
shared.error.submitter_forbidden: The submitter no longer has permission for this action; reject the request.
shared.partner.name: Partner name
shared.devui.about_day_grid: A calendar by day, seven cells to a row, with a month or week switch; on a phone the days stack in one column.
shared.devui.use_day_grid: reading a month or a week day by day.
shared.devui.avoid_day_grid: entering values by day: use CellGrid; listing records: use DataTable.
